user.title: Lionel Train Controller
user.description: Select a discovered Lionel train or enter the MAC address manually.

train_model.title: Select Train Model
train_model.description: Select your train model for **{name}**. This determines the announcement button labels. Choose 'Generic' if your train is not listed.

manual.title: Manual Configuration
manual.description: Enter your Lionel LionChief locomotive details manually. The train must currently be powered on and reachable through Home Assistant Bluetooth.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm Lionel Train Discovery
bluetooth_confirm.description: Discovered Lionel train: **{name}** at address `{address}`. Do you want to add it to Home Assistant?

error.cannot_connect: The train is not currently reachable through Home Assistant Bluetooth. Make sure it is powered on and in range of a local adapter or Bluetooth proxy.
error.no_devices_found: No Lionel trains are currently visible to Home Assistant Bluetooth. Power on the train, then reopen this flow or use manual entry.

abort.not_lionel_device: This device is not a Lionel LionChief locomotive
abort.unknown: The setup flow lost the selected train. Start the setup again.

entry_not_found.message: The selected Lionel train configuration no longer exists.

entry_not_loaded.message: The selected Lionel train configuration is not loaded.

no_loaded_entries.message: No Lionel train configurations are currently loaded.

entry_required.message: More than one Lionel train is configured. Select the train to control in the action.

action_failed.message: The Lionel train did not complete the requested action: {action}.
